style: リナの成人女性としての描画、容姿と服装は人物画のための美術上の選択。既存の弟イルとの関係・援助と契約の状態は物語に従い、経歴を追加しない。

files.prompt_en: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: one full-body transparent character sprite for a hand-painted low-fantasy RPG. Create Lina, a practical merchant who wants to offer aid to her younger brother, with a thoughtful, restrained expression suited to both a private request and an open negotiation. Art direction: an adult woman with dark chestnut hair tied in a low knot, a few loose strands, expressive brown eyes; a muted deep teal knee-length cloth merchant's coat over a soft ochre waistcoat and ivory linen shirt, dark brown trousers, plain belt and worn leather boots. No modern items. Natural adult proportions, carefully painted face and hands, softly directional warm lighting and subtle brush texture matching grounded fantasy character illustrations. She stands in a relaxed three-quarter pose turned slightly to the viewer's right. Both empty hands are visible, one lightly open at waist height while the other rests naturally at her side. Only one person. Full figure from hair to both boots, centered on a vertical 1024 by 1536 canvas, with comfortable transparent margins on every edge. True transparent background: every pixel outside the figure is transparent. No background scenery, floor, cast shadow, vignette, glow, lettering, logo, coins, aid parcel, paperwork, weapons, or additional people. Appearance and clothing are artistic choices only, without new biographical claims.
files.prompt_ja: 弟への援助について非公開と公開の相談をする商人リナの全身立ち絵。手描きローファンタジーRPG。成人女性として描き、暗い栗色の髪を低くまとめ、考え深く控えめな表情。深い青緑の膝丈の上着、黄土色の胴着、生成りのシャツ、焦茶のズボンと実用的な革靴。画面右へ少し体を向け、空の片手を腰の高さで軽く開き、もう片方は自然に下ろす。自然な頭身、繊細な筆致と暖色光。縦1024×1536の透明な画布中央に一人、髪・指・靴をすべて収め、周囲に透明な余白を取る。背景・床・影・光彩・文字・金銭・補給・契約書・武器・他の人物は入れない。外見と衣装を新しい経歴として本文へ追加しない。
